vendasReport.readOnlyNote: The figures in this report come only from the sales reports you import here (read by AI). Nothing is read from sales, cash flow, payables/receivables, revenue or stock, and nothing in them is changed.
vendasReport.loadError: Some report data could not be loaded. The figures below may be incomplete.
vendasReport.invalidRange: Invalid period: the start date must be on or before the end date.
vendasReport.empty: No sales in the selected period and filters
vendasReport.emptyHint: Adjust the period, product or channel. Only valid sales (no cancellations) are counted.
vendasReport.coverageTitle: Cost known for {pct} of net revenue
vendasReport.coverageBody: {count} sale(s) without a registered cost ({amount}) are left out of COGS, profit, margin, ROI and markup — they are never treated as zero cost. Products:
vendasReport.hintCmv: Cost of goods sold: units sold × unit cost in effect on the sale date.
vendasReport.hintProfit: Net revenue (sales − marketplace fees − returns) − COGS.
vendasReport.hintRoi: Gross profit ÷ COGS × 100. Unlike margin, the base is cost, not revenue.
vendasReport.netLine: Net revenue {net} = sales {gross} − marketplace fees {fees} − returns {returns}.
vendasReport.noPoints: No data in the period (missing costs).
vendasReport.needCosts: Enter product costs to see this ranking.
vendasReport.noCategoryNote: The system does not yet record product category or salesperson on sales, so the breakdown is by channel.
vendasReport.costsIntro: Enter the unit acquisition cost for products the report did not bring with a cost. A new cost applies from the given date: earlier sales keep the cost of their time, so changing a cost today does not rewrite historical analysis. Without a date, the first cost applies to all history. It is saved only in this report.
vendasReport.noProducts: No products in the imported reports.
vendasReport.importTitle: Import a sales report with AI
vendasReport.importHint: Paste lines as SKU;cost;date (date optional, YYYY-MM-DD). Decimal comma and Excel copy are accepted.
vendasReport.importIntro: Upload the sales report (PDF, CSV or TXT) or paste its text. The AI reads product, quantity, amount, date and, if present in the document, cost, fees and returns — nothing is invented. You review before saving.
vendasReport.uploadHint: PDF (up to 5 MB), CSV or TXT
vendasReport.pdfTooBig: PDF too large (5 MB limit). Send a shorter period or paste the text.
vendasReport.noneFound: The AI found no sales lines in this document.
vendasReport.pvWithCost: {n} of {total} with cost in the report
vendasReport.pvSkipped: {n} line(s) skipped for missing date or amount
vendasReport.pvHint: Untick anything that should not be included. An empty cost (—) means the report had no cost: enter it later under “Product costs”.
vendasReport.importDuplicate: This report looks already imported (same name, lines and total). Delete the previous import to re-import.
vendasReport.tooManyRows: Maximum {max} lines per import. Split the report into shorter periods.
vendasReport.manageIntro: Deleting an import removes only its data from this report; nothing else in the system is affected.
vendasReport.noImportsHint: Import a sales report (PDF, CSV or text): the AI reads the data and this panel computes sales, COGS, profit, margin and ROI. Nothing is pulled from other modules.
